verdict.headline: AMZN's 37% AWS beat meets the 30Y at a 19-year high before the ECI
verdict.label: AMZN +13% pre-market vs AAPL −7.2%; 30Y at 5.23% (highest since 2007) is the overnight structural development; ECI at 8:30 AM ET determines whether September tops 70% or retreats; SPX 7,380 is Day 2 of its regime test
verdict.rationale_short: Amazon's AWS grew 37% year-over-year — fastest in 18 quarters — sending Nasdaq futures up 1.1% overnight, but the 30Y has already moved to 5.23% (a new 19-year high, 11bps above Thursday's close) before the ECI release. The Q2 Employment Cost Index at 8:30 AM ET is the session's binary: at or below 0.8% QoQ and September probability retreats from ~63%, giving AMZN's pre-market momentum room to carry; at or above 1.1% and September re-prices above the 70% formal trigger, the 30Y extends, and SPX 7,380 — Day 2 of its required regime reversal — faces pressure from the rate side simultaneously with AAPL's pre-market drag.

dont_buy.reason: Three simultaneous misses (services $30.74B, China $18.82B, Q4 guidance +9-11%) are the exact metrics identified in prior briefings as the quality-rotation gatekeepers. The pre-market at ~$309 prices the headline quarter; it does not price a sustained services deceleration or structural China headwind extending through Q4 FY26.
dont_buy.better_entry: Post-Q4 FY26 earnings (October 2026) if services growth reaccelerates above 15% YoY. Or $305–310 on a regime-driven broad selloff that reprices quality names without fundamental differentiation.

trade_setups.thesis: The Q2 Employment Cost Index at 8:30 AM ET is the remaining rate-path uncertainty after Thursday's soft PCE and GDP. September probability is at ~63% pre-print — below the 70% trigger but elevated. A print above 1.1% QoQ restores September above 70% and likely extends 30Y beyond 5.25%, which is a new 19-year high above an already-high starting point. A print at 0.8% or below reverses the overnight 30Y move and validates Thursday's soft-landing re-pricing. The ECI, not the earnings queue, determines Friday's bond direction.
trade_setups.entry: Watch the 30Y move within 15 minutes of 8:30 AM ET as the signal: above 5.30% indicates hot; below 5.10% indicates soft. The print resolves the setup; the 30Y level is the market's real-time translation.
trade_setups.invalidation: ECI 0.9–1.0% QoQ (consensus range): September holds at 60–65%, no directional break in bonds.
trade_setups.horizon: Resolves within 30 minutes of 8:30 AM ET July 31

trade_setups.thesis: Thursday's close at 7,416 was Day 1 of a required two-session hold above 7,380 for a formal BEARISH regime reversal. Day 2 is today. The regime framework has reversed on one-session reclaims before. End-of-month flows typically amplify the direction of the close. A hot ECI and AAPL's pre-market drag are the two inputs most likely to force a close below 7,380, returning the regime to BEARISH. A soft ECI removes the primary risk and allows AMZN's momentum to carry.
trade_setups.entry: The level is a regime marker, not a trade entry. The confirming level is a Friday close above 7,380; the invalidating level is a Friday close below it.
trade_setups.invalidation: Friday close below 7,380 returns the regime to BEARISH; two consecutive closes above would be required again to reverse.
trade_setups.horizon: Resolves at Friday's 4 PM ET close

trade_setups.thesis: AMZN is +13% pre-market on AWS 37%. The GAAP EPS of $5.75 was inflated by a $53.4B Anthropic unrealized gain; operating income of $27.5B (~$110B annualized) is the fundamental metric. At $268 pre-market, the AWS AI thesis is priced alongside the Anthropic stake at a full market value. The AWS operating earnings justify approximately $245–255 without the one-time gain — that range is Friday's gap-fill anchor if ECI comes in hot and multiple compression sets in.
trade_setups.entry: The $250–255 range is where the operating earnings thesis holds without the Anthropic gain. $260 is the first interim resistance post-ECI. The pre-market $268 embeds both.
trade_setups.invalidation: ECI above 1.1% QoQ takes September above 70% and compresses multiples broadly; watch AMZN below $245 in that scenario.
trade_setups.horizon: Near-term: intraday Friday; medium-term: through NVDA August 26 earnings

bear_case: Thursday's PCE soft reading (Core +0.1% MoM) and GDP miss (+1.5% vs +2.1%) compressed September hike odds to 45% in one session — a move that priced in a soft ECI to follow. The 30Y has already moved to 5.23% overnight (highest since 2007) without the ECI data, suggesting the bond market is not treating Thursday as a regime shift. If the Q2 ECI prints above 1.1% QoQ, September probability jumps above 70%, the 30Y extends toward 5.30–5.35%, and SPX loses 7,380 on Day 2, reverting the regime to BEARISH. AAPL's −7.2% pre-market adds a Nasdaq headwind that doesn't need ECI to be real. The read does not hold if SPX closes below 7,380 today.
